name: – Isabella Lövin – After § 36 – Am 3
title: REPORT on the multiannual plan for the Baltic Sea and ways forward
part_text: 36c. Highlights the fact that seabirds are prone to becoming entangled in various types of static nets and that, according to the Baltic Marine Environment Protection Commission, seabird bycatch numbers are often significantly higher than those reported in official reports; calls on the Commission and the Member States to fully uphold and where necessary strengthen measures to protect seabirds against negative impacts;
